license_required.quote: Every person before practicing medicine and surgery or any of the branches or departments of medicine and surgery, within the meaning of the Oklahoma Allopathic Medical and Surgical Licensure and Supervision Act...within this state, must be in legal possession of the unrevoked license or certificate issued pursuant to the Oklahoma Allopathic Medical and Surgical Licensure and Supervision Act

issuing_authority.value: State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision
issuing_authority.quote: a license, in form approved by the State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision and attested by the seal of the Board, shall be issued to the applicant by the Board

name.value: State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision
name.quote: a license, in form approved by the State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision and attested by the seal of the Board, shall be issued to the applicant by the Board

type.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision may appoint a Board secretary to carry out the statutory duties of the Oklahoma Allopathic Medical and Surgical Licensure and Supervision Act.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be physically, mentally, professionally, and morally capable of practicing medicine and surgery in a manner reasonably acceptable to the Board

degree_required.quote: The applicant shall possess a valid degree of Doctor of Medicine from a medical college or school located in the United States, its territories or possessions, or Canada that was approved by the Board or by a private nonprofit accrediting body approved by the Board at the time the degree was conferred.

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved or private nonprofit accrediting body approved by the Board
accrediting_body.quote: from a medical college or school located in the United States, its territories or possessions, or Canada that was approved by the Board or by a private nonprofit accrediting body approved by the Board at the time the degree was conferred

required.quote: The applicant shall have satisfactorily completed twelve (12) months of progressive postgraduate medical training as promulgated by rule by the Board.

duration.quote: satisfactorily completed twelve (12) months of progressive postgraduate medical training

kind.quote: twelve (12) months of progressive postgraduate medical training as promulgated by rule by the Board

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Applicant shall have passed medical licensing examination(s) consistent with USMLE policies; Board may grant exceptions.
exams.quote: The applicant shall have passed medical licensing examination(s) consistent with policies and procedures regarding the number of medical licensure exam attempts as established by the United States Medical Licensing Examination program unless granted an exception by the Board.

exams.name: National Boards Examination (National Board of Medical Examiners)
exams.notes: Accepted for licensure by endorsement as an alternative to state examination.
exams.quote: Has passed the National Boards Examination administered by the National Board of Medical Examiners, provided the Board determines that such examination was equivalent to the Board's examination used at the time of application.

available.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision may issue a license by endorsement to an applicant who: 1. Has complied with all current medical licensure requirements except those for examination; and 2. Has passed a medical licensure examination given in English in another state, the District of Columbia, a territory or possession of the United States, or Canada

requirements.value: Applicant must comply with all current medical licensure requirements except examination, and must have passed a medical licensure examination in another state, DC, US territory, or Canada, or the National Boards Examination, provided the Board determines equivalency.
requirements.quote: Has complied with all current medical licensure requirements except those for examination; and Has passed a medical licensure examination given in English in another state, the District of Columbia, a territory or possession of the United States, or Canada, or has passed the National Boards Examination administered by the National Board of Medical Examiners, provided the Board determines that such examination was equivalent to the Board's examination used at the time of application.

exists.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision may appoint a Board secretary to carry out the statutory duties of the Oklahoma Allopathic Medical and Surgical Licensure and Supervision Act.

national_certification.value: Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG)
national_certification.quote: A foreign applicant for full and unrestricted licensure shall possess the degree of Doctor of Medicine or a Board-approved equivalent based on satisfactory completion of educational programs from a foreign medical school as evidenced by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG).

national_association.value: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME)
national_association.quote: The Board shall consider as evidence of acceptability the sponsoring institution's accreditation by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME)

credential_type.quote: a license, in form approved by the State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision and attested by the seal of the Board, shall be issued to the applicant by the Board, authorizing the applicant to practice medicine and surgery

title_protection.quote: The use of the title Doctor of Medicine, Physician, Surgeon, Physician and Surgeon, Dr., M.D. or any combination thereof in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of human disease or condition unless, where appropriate, such a designation additionally contains the description of another branch of the healing arts for which one holds a valid license in this state.

scope_protection.quote: Every person before practicing medicine and surgery or any of the branches or departments of medicine and surgery...within this state, must be in legal possession of the unrevoked license or certificate issued pursuant to the Oklahoma Allopathic Medical and Surgical Licensure and Supervision Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring, aiding or abetting a criminal operation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, aiding or abetting a criminal operation;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or offering to accept a fee on the promise that a manifestly incurable disease can be cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The obtaining of any fee or offering to accept any fee, present or other form of remuneration whatsoever, on the assurance or promise that a manifestly incurable disease can or will be cured;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully betraying a professional secret to the detriment of the patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully betraying a professional secret to the detriment of the patient;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intemperance or habitual use of habit-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intemperance or the habitual use of habit-forming drugs;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction, confession, or plea to a felony or any offense involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction or confession of, or plea of guilty, nolo contendere, no contest or Alford plea to a felony or any offense involving moral turpitude;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising medical business with grossly untrue or misleading statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All advertising of medical business in which statements are made which are grossly untrue or improbable and calculated to mislead the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction or plea to a crime involving violation of antinarcotic or prohibition laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction or confession of, or plea of guilty, nolo contendere, no contest or Alford plea to a crime involving violation of: a. the antinarcotic or prohibition laws and regulations of the federal government, b. the laws of this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonorable or immoral conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonorable or immoral conduct which is likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act that is a criminal law violation connected with the physician's practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any act which is a violation of the criminal laws of any state when such act is connected with the physician's practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to keep complete and accurate records of purchase and disposal of controlled or narcotic drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to keep complete and accurate records of purchase and disposal of controlled drugs or of narcotic drugs;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Writing false or fictitious prescriptions for controlled or narcotic drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The writing of false or fictitious prescriptions for any drugs or narcotics declared by the laws of this state to be controlled or narcotic drugs;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or administering a drug or treatment without sufficient examination and a valid physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or administering a drug or treatment without sufficient examination and the establishment of a valid physician-patient relationship and not prescribing in a safe, medically accepted manner;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation or attempted violation of any provision of the Oklahoma Allopathic Medical and Surgical Licensure and Supervision Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation, or attempted violation, direct or indirect, of any of the provisions of the Oklahoma Allopathic Medical and Surgical Licensure and Supervision Act, either as a principal, accessory or accomplice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by any person not duly authorized
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting, directly or indirectly, the practice of medicine by any person not duly authorized under the laws of this state;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to age, illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of age, illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering controlled substances or narcotic drugs in excess of good medical practice or without medical need
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or administering of controlled substances or narcotic drugs in excess of the amount considered good medical practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in physical conduct with a patient that is sexual in nature, or verbal behavior that is seductive or sexually demeaning
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in physical conduct with a patient which is sexual in nature, or in any verbal behavior which is seductive or sexually demeaning to a patient;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain an office record for each patient accurately reflecting evaluation, treatment, and medical necessity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain an office record for each patient which accurately reflects the evaluation, treatment, and medical necessity of treatment of the patient;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide necessary ongoing medical treatment when a doctor-patient relationship has been established
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide necessary ongoing medical treatment when a doctor-patient relationship has been established, which relationship can be severed by either party providing a reasonable period of time is granted;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of an abortion except as necessary to prevent death or substantial irreversible physical impairment of the mother
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of an abortion as defined by Section 1-730 of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes, except for an abortion necessary to prevent the death of the mother or to prevent substantial or irreversible physical impairment of the mother that substantially increases the risk of death.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide a proper and safe medical facility setting and qualified assistive personnel for a recognized medical act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide a proper and safe medical facility setting and qualified assistive personnel for a recognized medical act, including but not limited to an initial in-person patient examination, office surgery, diagnostic service or any other medical procedure or treatment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly providing gender transition procedures to a child
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly providing gender transition procedures as defined in Section 1 of this act to a child.

definition_quote.value: Every person shall be regarded as practicing allopathic medicine within the meaning and provisions of this act, who shall append to his or her name the letters 'M.D.', 'Physician' or any other title, letters or designation which represent that such person is a physician, or who shall for a fee or any form of compensation diagnose and/or treat disease, injury or deformity of persons in this state by any allopathic legend drugs, surgery, manual, or mechanical treatment unless otherwise authorized by law.
definition_quote.quote: Every person shall be regarded as practicing allopathic medicine within the meaning and provisions of this act, who shall append to his or her name the letters "M.D.", "Physician" or any other title, letters or designation which represent that such person is a physician, or who shall for a fee or any form of compensation diagnose and/or treat disease, injury or deformity of persons in this state by any allopathic legend drugs, surgery, manual, or mechanical treatment unless otherwise authorized by law.

value: treatment of disease, injury or deformity
methods_authorized.quote: diagnose and/or treat disease, injury or deformity of persons in this state by any allopathic legend drugs, surgery, manual, or mechanical treatment unless otherwise authorized by law.

drug_authority.value: Authorized to prescribe, order, give, or administer drugs or medicine; may prescribe controlled substances subject to limits
drug_authority.quote: Any offer or attempt to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine and surgery for the use of any other person, except as otherwise authorized by law;

license_status_types.quote: The Board authorizes the issuance of conditional, restricted, or otherwise circumscribed licenses, or issuance of licenses under terms of agreement, for all licenses under its jurisdiction

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign applicants must possess a Doctor of Medicine degree or equivalent evidenced by ECFMG certification, have a command of English satisfactory to the Board (determined by ECFMG), complete 12-24 months of Board-approved progressive graduate medical training as required by rule, provide evidence of immigration status, and submit original source verification of ECFMG or MCCQUE certification.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A foreign applicant for full and unrestricted licensure shall possess the degree of Doctor of Medicine or a Board-approved equivalent based on satisfactory completion of educational programs from a foreign medical school as evidenced by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG).

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: The applicant shall have satisfactorily completed twelve (12) months of progressive postgraduate medical training as promulgated by rule by the Board.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Prescribing opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes constitutes unprofessional conduct.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes;

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby enacted into law and the Governor shall enter into a compact on behalf of the State of Oklahoma with any jurisdiction legally joined therein

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: "Practice agreement" means a written agreement between a physician assistant and a delegating physician concerning the scope of practice of the physician assistant to only be determined by the delegating physician and the physician assistant based on the education, training, skills and experience of the physician assistant.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe within the scope defined by the practice agreement, which shall include the scope of and any limitations on prescribing, as determined by the delegating physician and the physician assistant.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: The agreement shall involve the joint formulation, discussion and agreement on the methods of supervision and collaboration for diagnosis, consultation and treatment of medical conditions and shall include the scope of and any limitations on prescribing.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: There is hereby established the Allied Professional Peer Assistance Program to rehabilitate allied medical professionals whose competency may be compromised because of the abuse of drugs or alcohol, so that such allied medical professionals can be treated and can return to or continue the practice of allied medical practice in a manner which will benefit the public. The program shall be under the supervision and control of the State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: In enforcing this section the State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision may, upon probable cause, request a physician to submit to a mental or physical examination by physicians designated by it.
